source_format: Linux perf_event_attr plus native perf event records
limitations: Execution wall time brackets launcher release through observed leader exit, including exec/loader work; user/system rusage has microsecond source resolution.
Inherited sampling is restricted to the selected CPU and observed leader lifetime. A task that changes affinity or outlives the leader has unknown additional coverage.
CPU-clock sample periods are source weights, not exact invocation counts or instrumented function durations. User-mode sampling does not prove the preceding period contained only user-mode work.
Frame-pointer callchain completeness, symbol coverage, kernel losses, task lifetimes and initial scheduling state require separate source/import checks.
